The '''president of the Association for Computing Machinery''' is the highest officer of the [[Association for Computing Machinery]] (ACM) who sets the direction for ACM during their tenure. Below is a list of everyone who has held that position.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://www.acm.org/about-acm/past-presidents |title= ACM Past Presidents |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= [[Association for Computing Machinery]] |publisher= |access-date= 13 January 2026 |quote= }}</ref>
